scope: Stage-2 authority, exact pinned tree, root/module READMEs and dependency metadata were inspected statically. Major in-repository scientific families were bounded as experiments; concrete problem/method variants were configurations. External repositories and stored result/post-processing artifacts were not promoted into CR000202 experiments. No scientific workload was executed.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository-level license was identified at the pinned commit.
Stage 2 asserts no Atlas-paper relationship for CR000202; none is inferred.
AIVT and MR-AIV code are hosted in separate repositories and are excluded from CR000202 experiment scope.
Root installation is documented, but module-level dependency versions remain incompletely pinned and are not normalized independently.
Historical result arrays and post-processing artifacts are static evidence only; their numerical validity was not revalidated.
Caches, stored result variants and post-processing artifacts are retained as supporting evidence rather than independent experiments.

notes: Seven major in-repository experiment families and twenty-two configurations are represented.
